mocodes.label: Music – Faculty Travel
mocodes.why: Faculty conference travel, professional meetings, research travel, audition travel, travel to serve as an accreditation evaluator, and related professional development expenses.

ambiguity.guidance: Use this code when one of our faculty travels — including travel to serve as a NAST, NASM, NASD, or URTA evaluator. When the Conservatory is hosting a visiting accreditation team and paying their travel, lodging, or meals, that is an administrative cost of the school rather than faculty travel — use KDH80 (Music – Office Operations, Program K8948).

mocodes.label: Music – Faculty Searches
mocodes.why: Faculty recruitment, candidate travel, onboarding support, search processes, and faculty hiring-related operational expenses.

mocodes.label: Music – Instructional Support
mocodes.why: Instructional supplies, classroom and studio materials, curriculum support resources, and academic instructional expenses.

ambiguity.guidance: Use KJ528 for materials used in teaching (method books, classroom supplies). Use KJ540 for music purchased specifically for ensemble performance or concerts.

mocodes.label: Music – Student Recruitment
mocodes.why: Recruitment travel, auditions, campus visit events, admissions operations, recruiting materials, and student outreach efforts.

mocodes.label: Music – External Relations
mocodes.why: Marketing, communications, donor relations, fundraising support, public-facing events, and external relations operations for the Music division.

ambiguity.guidance: Use this code for the division's professional and organizational memberships. NASM accreditation fees and dues are not coded here — those go to KDH80 with the rest of the division's accreditation costs.

mocodes.label: Music – Visiting Artists (Academic)
mocodes.why: Guest artists, masterclasses, lecturers, clinicians, and residencies supporting curricular activity. For production guest artists, use Music Productions (KJ541).

ambiguity.guidance: Use KJ531 when the guest artist is visiting for a masterclass, residency, or curricular purpose. Use KJ541 when the artist is performing in or directing a specific production.

mocodes.label: Music – Office Operations

examples: Meals hosted for a visiting accreditation team
Airfare for a visiting accreditation team
Per diem or meals for evaluators while traveling

mocodes.why: Office supplies, postage, printing, duplication, and day-to-day administrative operations of the Music division. Also the home for the division's accreditation costs: NASM fees and dues, and the expense of hosting a visiting accreditation or site-evaluation team.

ambiguity.guidance: Use this code for the Music division's own accreditation costs — NASM fees and dues, and hosting a visiting evaluation team. Use KJ525 when one of our own faculty travels to serve as an evaluator for another institution; that is faculty professional activity, not a cost of keeping our program accredited.

mocodes.label: Music – Technical Services
mocodes.why: Instrument maintenance, piano tuning, equipment repair, and related technical support services. Distinct from Technology Services (KJ536).

mocodes.label: Music – Student Operational Workers
mocodes.why: Admin, front desk, technical, and non-academic student worker roles. Not accompanists (K9561), or curricular student workers (K9557).

ambiguity.also: KJ538 Accompanist Services or KJ539 Curricular Student Worker Support
ambiguity.guidance: Use KJ534 for students in operational/administrative roles (front desk, office help, non-academic tech). Use KJ538 for student accompanists. Use KJ539 for students in ensemble conducting or other curricular support roles.

mocodes.notes: Compensation flow — triggered by worker type selection

mocodes.label: Music – Equipment
mocodes.why: Equipment purchases, rentals, leases, repairs, replacements, and operational equipment support activity.

ambiguity.guidance: Use KJ535 for purchasing or replacing equipment. Use KDH82 for repairing or maintaining instruments and equipment (piano tuning, instrument repair).

mocodes.label: Music – Technology
mocodes.why: Software licenses, electronic media systems, instructional technology, digital platforms, computing support, and technology-related operational services.

mocodes.label: Music – Student Touring
mocodes.why: Ensemble tours, conference attendance, student competition travel, off-campus performances, and related student travel activity.

mocodes.label: Music – Accompanist Services

examples: Student academic worker in accompanying role

mocodes.why: Student academic workers serving as accompanists supporting instructional activity, rehearsals, classes, coaching, and performance preparation.
mocodes.notes: Compensation flow — triggered by worker type selection. Account 703800 identifies these as student academic workers.

mocodes.label: Music – Curricular Student Worker Support
mocodes.why: Student worker positions providing curricular support, including ensemble conducting. Replaces old program K8971 (CONDUCTING ENSEMBLE). Do not use K9576/707100 for these positions.
mocodes.notes: Compensation flow — triggered by worker type selection.

mocodes.label: Music – Performance Materials
mocodes.why: Performance scores, ensemble music purchases, sheet music rentals, and related music library and performance materials. Program identifier (K8967) is pending final assignment from K8967–K8984 range.

ambiguity.guidance: Use KJ540 for music purchased for ensemble performance or concerts. Use KJ528 for music or materials used primarily in classroom instruction (method books, theory texts).

mocodes.notes: Program K8967 confirmed by the fiscal office 7/28/2026.

mocodes.notes: Royalties and licensing are folded into this MoCode via Account 750000 or 750900.

compensationRules.programNote: Music: always use Program K9561 — MoCode KJ538. Dance: always use Program K9561 — MoCode KJ523.
compensationRules.why: Student academic workers serving as accompanists are coded to K9561 in both Music and Dance. Account 703800 identifies the student academic worker category.
examples: Student pianist for a Dance technique class
Student piano accompanist for studio class

compensationRules.workerType: Curricular student worker — Music (ensemble conducting, curricular support)
compensationRules.programNote: Always use Program K9557 — MoCode KJ539. Do NOT use K9576 (707100) for these positions.
compensationRules.why: Student workers in curricular support roles (including ensemble conducting) use K9557. This replaces old program K8971 (CONDUCTING ENSEMBLE). Account 703800 identifies the student academic worker category.
examples: Student assigned to conduct an ensemble
Student in a curricular support role

compensationRules.workerType: Student operational worker (admin, front desk, tech support)
compensationRules.programNote: Always use Program K9576. Use the divisional DeptID (K1306001, K1305002, K0923001) matching where the student works.
compensationRules.why: Non-academic student workers in admin, front desk, technical, and operational roles use Account 707100 and Program K9576. Distinct from academic student workers (703800).
examples: Student helping with non-academic technical tasks

compensationRules.programNote: Use the production MoCode for that division: Theatre KJ558 (general labor) or KJ554 (show-specific performance operations); Dance KJ524; Music KJ541; cross-divisional/Nexus KJ561.
compensationRules.why: Production overhire and stagehands are coded as part-time staff (705500) or overtime (708050) under the production Program and DeptID for that division.
examples: Production labor for a specific show
